# payment — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Payment protocols — auto-pay gated APIs and agent-to-agent payment links. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl payment <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

Contents (22): pay · quote · decode-receipt · pay-local · default set · default get · default unset · a2a-pay create · a2a-pay pay · a2a-pay status · charge · session open · session voucher · session topup · session close · subscription subscribe · subscription access · subscription change · subscription cancel · subscription cancel-pending · subscription my-subscriptions · subscription allowance-status

### payment pay
Sign a payment authorization for an HTTP 402-gated resource and return the assembled `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header (x402 v2)
`ocl payment pay [options]`
- `--payload <PAYLOAD>` — base64 of the decoded 402 payload `{x402Version, resource, accepts}` — i.e. the raw `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header value (base64 or base64url)
- `--payment-id <PAYMENT_ID>` — Two-phase mode: complete the payment persisted by `payment quote`
- `--selected-index <SELECTED_INDEX>` — Optional 0-based index into the payload's `accepts[]` to sign
- `--param <PARAM>` (repeatable) — Additional business param, repeatable: --param key=value
- `--yes` — Approve the fund-moving payment (bypass the confirming gate)

### payment quote
Probe a 402/A2MCP endpoint, parse the challenge, preflight balance, rank candidates, and persist a paymentId
`ocl payment quote <URL> [options]`
- `--param <PARAM>` (repeatable) — Known business param, repeatable: --param key=value
- `--method <METHOD>` — HTTP method to probe the endpoint with (GET by default) (default GET)
- `--tool <TOOL>` — MCP tool to invoke via tools/call
- `URL` — The A2MCP / merchant endpoint to probe

### payment decode-receipt
Decode an x402 PAYMENT-RESPONSE header or a charge receipt into {status, transaction, amount, payer, chainId}
`ocl payment decode-receipt [options]`
- `--header <HEADER>` — x402 PAYMENT-RESPONSE header (base64/base64url)
- `--receipt <RECEIPT>` — Raw charge receipt JSON

### payment pay-local
Sign an x402 payment locally with a hex private key (reads EVM_PRIVATE_KEY env var)
`ocl payment pay-local --payload <PAYLOAD>`

### payment default set
Save an asset + chain as the default
`ocl payment default set --asset <ASSET> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--name <NAME>` — Display name shown in notifications, e.g. "USDT"
- `--tier <TIER>` — Tier the user just confirmed: `basic` or `premium`

### payment default get
Show the saved default payment asset (if any)
`ocl payment default get`

### payment default unset
Clear the saved default payment asset
`ocl payment default unset`

### payment a2a-pay create
Seller: create a payment authorization, returns paymentId + challenge
`ocl payment a2a-pay create --type <TYPE> --amount <AMOUNT> --symbol <SYMBOL> [options]`
- `--recipient <RECIPIENT>` — Seller wallet address (= EIP-3009 `to`)
- `--description <DESCRIPTION>` — Human-readable description shown to the Buyer
- `--realm <REALM>` — Realm — Seller / provider domain (e.g. "provider.example.com")
- `--external-id <EXTERNAL_ID>` — Optional external business id (e.g. task id)
- `--expires-in <EXPIRES_IN>` — Payment-link expiration window in seconds

### payment a2a-pay pay
Buyer: fetch challenge by id, sign EIP-3009, submit credential
`ocl payment a2a-pay pay --payment-id <PAYMENT_ID> --amount <AMOUNT> --currency <CURRENCY> --recipient-address <RECIPIENT_ADDRESS>`

### payment a2a-pay status
Query payment status by id
`ocl payment a2a-pay status --payment-id <PAYMENT_ID> [options]`
- `--wait` — Poll internally (3s interval, 60s ceiling) until terminal or timeout

### payment charge
Sign a one-shot Charge payment (EIP-3009 via TEE) or wrap a client-broadcast hash
`ocl payment charge --challenge <CHALLENGE> [options]`
- `--from <FROM>` — Payer address (optional, defaults to selected account)
- `--tx-hash <TX_HASH>` — Optional: tx hash of a client-broadcast transferWithAuthorization (hash mode)

### payment session open
Open a payment channel
`ocl payment session open --challenge <CHALLENGE> --deposit <DEPOSIT> [options]`
- `--from <FROM>` — Payer address (optional, defaults to selected account)
- `--tx-hash <TX_HASH>` — Optional: tx hash of the client-broadcast open tx (hash mode)
- `--salt <SALT>` — Hash mode only: the bytes32 salt (0x + 64 hex) you passed to `escrow.open(...)` on-chain
- `--initial-cum <INITIAL_CUM>` — Initial voucher cumulativeAmount (atomic units)
- `--prepay-first` — Pre-authorize one unit of payment at open time

### payment session voucher
Sign an EIP-712 cumulative-amount voucher via TEE, or reuse a previously-signed voucher's bytes (`--reuse-signature`) to spend remaining channel balance with…
`ocl payment session voucher --challenge <CHALLENGE> --channel-id <CHANNEL_ID> --cumulative-amount <CUMULATIVE_AMOUNT> [options]`
- `--escrow <ESCROW>` — Escrow contract address
- `--chain-id <CHAIN_ID>` — Chain ID (e.g. 196 for X Layer)
- `--from <FROM>` — Payer address (optional, defaults to selected account)
- `--reuse-signature <REUSE_SIGNATURE>` — Reuse a previously-signed voucher: hex 65-byte signature that was returned by an earlier `payment session voucher` / `payment session open` call

### payment session topup
TopUp a payment channel (EIP-3009 to escrow via TEE, or hash-mode wrap)
`ocl payment session topup --challenge <CHALLENGE> --channel-id <CHANNEL_ID> --additional-deposit <ADDITIONAL_DEPOSIT> --escrow <ESCROW> --chain-id <CHAIN_ID> [options]`
- `--currency <CURRENCY>` — ERC-20 token contract (required in transaction mode)
- `--from <FROM>` — Payer address (optional, defaults to selected account)
- `--tx-hash <TX_HASH>` — Optional: tx hash of client-broadcast topUp tx (hash mode)

### payment session close
Close a payment channel (sign final voucher via TEE)
`ocl payment session close --channel-id <CHANNEL_ID> --cumulative-amount <CUMULATIVE_AMOUNT> --escrow <ESCROW> --chain-id <CHAIN_ID> --challenge <CHALLENGE> [options]`
- `--from <FROM>` — Payer address (optional, defaults to selected account)

### payment subscription subscribe
Sign a subscribe double-signature (PermitSingle + SubscriptionTerms) for a `period` 402 and emit the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
`ocl payment subscription subscribe --accepts <ACCEPTS> [options]`
- `--from <FROM>` — Payer address (optional; defaults to the selected account)
- `--url <URL>` — Resource URL (used as the header `resource.url` and the cache key)

### payment subscription access
Build an `APP-Access` AccessProof header for a resource URL: resolve the active subId (cache or `--sub-id`), then personal-sign `(subId, payer, timestamp)`
`ocl payment subscription access --url <URL> [options]`
- `--sub-id <SUB_ID>` — Explicit subId override (skips the cache lookup)
- `--from <FROM>` — Payer address (optional; defaults to the selected account)
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain name or index (default: xlayer) (default xlayer)

### payment subscription change
Sign a change (up/downgrade) double-signature from a change-offer 402
`ocl payment subscription change --accepts <ACCEPTS> [options]`
- `--sub-id <SUB_ID>` — The subId being changed (overrides `extra.changeFrom.fromSubId`)
- `--from <FROM>`
- `--url <URL>` — Resource URL (cache key for the resulting subscription)

### payment subscription cancel
Sign a CancelAuth to cancel a subscription (delivered to the Seller)
`ocl payment subscription cancel --sub-id <SUB_ID> [options]`
- `--contract <CONTRACT>` — Subscription contract address (EIP-712 domain)
- `--token <TOKEN>` — ERC-20 token — only needed to look up the contract when `--contract` is omitted
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain name or index (default: xlayer) (default xlayer)
- `--from <FROM>`

### payment subscription cancel-pending
Sign a PendingChangeCancelAuth to cancel a not-yet-effective downgrade
`ocl payment subscription cancel-pending --sub-id <SUB_ID> --new-sub-id <NEW_SUB_ID> [options]`
- `--contract <CONTRACT>`
- `--token <TOKEN>`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` (default xlayer)
- `--from <FROM>`

### payment subscription my-subscriptions
List the buyer's own subscriptions (buyer-direct) and reconcile the local subId cache
`ocl payment subscription my-subscriptions [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` (default xlayer)
- `--from <FROM>`
- `--limit <LIMIT>` (default 50)
- `--offset <OFFSET>` (default 0)

### payment subscription allowance-status
Query Permit2 allowance status (buyer-direct): nonce / reserved / contracts / layer-1 allowance
`ocl payment subscription allowance-status --token <TOKEN> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` (default xlayer)
- `--from <FROM>`
